test_index_take: test the Index.take method to retrieve elements by integer indexer positions
test_index_contains: test the Index.__contains__ method to verify membership of scalar values in an Index
test_index_get_loc: test the Index.get_loc method to find the position of a label in an Index
test_index_get_indexer: test the Index.get_indexer_for method to map target labels to source Index positions
test_index_putmask: test the Index.putmask method to apply a boolean mask and fill values
